used_lines: sab kuch wahi hai bas / woh jo har waqt sath tha / woh nahi hai ab
sab kehte hain waqt sab theek kar deta hai, / mera waqt to bas yaadein de gaya.
kuch cheezein bikhar jayein to wapas nahi judti, / jaise teri kami ab kabhi poori nahi hoti.
sab kehte hain akela rehna buri baat hai, / par bheed mein bhi to main akela hi tha.
kuch log zindagi mein aate hain / aur hamesha ke liye yaadein chhor jaate hain
kuch baatein dil mein hi achi lagti hain, / zuban par aate hi rishtey tod deti hain.
